sara (support): Customer acct-omega reporting invoice inv_8921 shows ~120 extra tokens vs dashboard after a streaming session. They say they cancelled mid-gen, reconnected, and invoice charged both runs. session_id=sess_abc123. Can we triage?

mike (eng-oncall): Got it — can you paste the ledger lines and any server trace IDs? My first guess is a finalize race on reconnect.

sara (support): Pasting customer-provided ledger snippets and server logs we pulled: 
```
ledger: 2026-04-10T14:12:03Z session=sess_abc123 conn=conn-01 event=delta tokens=320
ledger: 2026-04-10T14:12:10Z session=sess_abc123 conn=conn-01 event=finalize tokens=320 finalization_id=fin-A
ledger: 2026-04-10T14:12:11Z session=sess_abc123 conn=conn-02 event=delta tokens=120
ledger: 2026-04-10T14:12:15Z session=sess_abc123 conn=conn-02 event=finalize tokens=120 finalization_id=fin-B
invoice: charged inv_8921 lines: fin-A 320, fin-B 120
dashboard: shows latest finalized tokens 320 (only fin-A)
```

sara (support): Customer says client did a quick reconnect within ~3s after cancelling. They shared client logs showing an immediate reopen with same session_id.

olivia (billing): I see two finalize entries tied to same session_id. System charged both finalization rows -> invoice +120 tokens. Dashboard reconciliation appears to only show the earlier finalize (or the later one overwrote display) so user sees mismatch. We can provisionally credit 120 tokens, but need eng root cause. :money_with_wings:

jason (eng-runtime): Initial hypothesis: aggregator finalization isn't idempotent for streaming sessions when connections are short-lived. We rely on per-connection finalize events (finalization_id) but we don't dedupe by session_id+generation_nonce. If a reconnect triggers a new generation that completes, orphaned previous connection may still cause a finalize that gets inserted into ledger.

jason (eng-runtime): Repro idea: open SSE with session_id, stream partial deltas, force client-side disconnect before final frame, reopen with same session_id and finish generation. If aggregator doesn't mark the orphan as aborted/merged, both finalization events can be recorded.

mike (eng-oncall): Can you provide a concise repro script we can run in staging? Also want the exact window where this happens — is there a grace period setting?

sara (support): Repro steps customer used (minimal):
1) curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?session_id=sess_abc123" 
2) receive a few delta frames (tokens accumulating)
3) client issues SIGINT (simulates cancel) after partials, do not send explicit close/finalize
4) within 3s, reopen same endpoint with same session_id and finish generation -> second finalize appears

Example SSE frames (customer captured):
```
data: {"type":"delta","tokens":120}

data: {"type":"delta","tokens":200}

# client disconnects here (no final event)

data: {"type":"delta","tokens":120}

data: {"type":"final","tokens":120}
```

jason (eng-runtime): Perfect, can reproduce locally with that pattern. Logs show: 
```
runtime: mark_orphan session=sess_abc123 conn=conn-01 reason=disconnect grace=5s
aggregator: finalize event received session=sess_abc123 conn=conn-02 finalization_id=fin-B tokens=120
ledger: write finalize fin-A tokens=320
ledger: write finalize fin-B tokens=120
```

jason (eng-runtime): Root cause: we allow orphan finalizes to be persisted during grace window; if reconnected connection completes we currently don't canonicalize/merge the two finalizes. Fix: make finalize idempotent at session scope — attach a canonical finalization token (session_finalization_marker) on first finalize and ignore subsequent finalizes for same session unless explicitly replacing.

jason (eng-runtime): Plan: add dedupe on write path (check for existing session_finalized flag), add reconciliation job to detect suspect double-finalizes, and add unit test for reconnect case. Target: patch + staging deploy in 48h, prod hotfix in 72h if green.

olivia (billing): Thanks. Please also emit a reconciliation flag so we can auto-detect already-charged duplicate finalizes. I will open a refund workflow for acct-omega (requested provisional credit 120 tokens) and hold off issuing final credit until we confirm fix.

mike (eng-oncall): @jason please PR the dedupe change and include telemetry: session_id, finalization_id, conn_id, reconcile_flag. Also note expected behavior in streaming docs (we should document that clients should send explicit final event on graceful close).

sara (support): I'll update the customer and ask them to confirm if they used an official SDK or custom SSE client. If SDK, we should push a client update with explicit graceful-close semantics.

billing-bot: Ticket BILL-8342 created for provisional credit. Status: pending-engineering-fix.

mike (eng-oncall): Action items summary:
- jason: implement idempotent finalize + staging deploy (48h)
- jason: add reconciliation job to find dup finalizes (post-deploy)
- olivia: provisional credit applied, monitor for more accounts
- sara: follow up with customer, ask for SDK vs custom client

sara (support): thanks everyone — will keep thread updated. :eyes:
